question: ‘Goal’ is the autobiography of _______.
solution:
The Correct Answer is**Major Dhyanchand.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **'Goal' is the autobiography of Major Dhyan Chand, **a legendary figure in **Indian and world hockey.**
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand** is often referred to as the** "Wizard of Hockey"** for his extraordinary goal-scoring feats.
 
• He led India to three **Olympic gold medals in 1928, 1932, and 1936.**
 
• His autobiography, **'Goal', details his life**, his passion for hockey, and the journey of Indian hockey during his playing days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 Option 3
